rdf:description.dc:title: Cute cartoon bear standing isolated on transparent background
rdf:description.dc:description: A charming cartoon illustration of a brown bear standing upright. The animal is depicted in a simple, flat design style with clear outlines and a friendly expression, isolated on a transparent background.
